# Rerecast source

This directory contains the published Rerecast 0.4.0 crate with upstream pull
request 72 applied. The patch repairs contours around enclosed obstacles and
fixes detail-mesh jitter overflow. It retains the Recast Navigation attribution
in `src/contours/holes.rs`.

Source: <https://github.com/janhohenheim/rerecast>
Patch: <https://github.com/janhohenheim/rerecast/pull/72>
